description: This Java source file implements a WearableListenerService that handles DataItems and Messages from wearable devices, managing data exchange and triggering activities based on received messages.

classes.name: DataLayerListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens to DataItems and Messages from the wearable data layer, facilitating inter-device communication and starting activities based on received messages.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and connects to the Wearable API when the service is created.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming DataEvents, checks connection status, retrieves data item URI, and sends messages based on specific data paths.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming MessageEvents, and starts MainActivity if the message path matches START_ACTIVITY_PATH.

methods.name: LOGD
methods.description: A utility method for logging debug messages if enabled.
